svg.text: Sub-Second Ingestion & Real-Time State Ingestion on AWS
Region: ap-southeast-1 | S3 Event-Driven Serverless Pipeline (Scale-to-Zero)

g.text: Target of direct browser / API document uploads
Parses S3 event records, extracts key & size
Scale-to-Zero: Zero idle costs when no files uploaded
Memory Size: 128 MB | Max Used: 83 MB
• Event Ingestion Latency: Sub-second response (214 ms - 257 ms) eliminating polling latency and CPU waste on EC2.
• Security & Least Privilege: Lambda function operates under huylam-ocr-lambda-role with inline policies restricted to specific S3 and DynamoDB ARNs.
• FinOps Excellence: True Scale-to-Zero architecture costing 0.00 USD within AWS Free Tier limits (1,000,000 calls / month).
